description: In sieve_admin.rs, user_exists() compares the incoming username against GLOBAL_SCRIPT_KEY with case-insensitive ASCII comparison, but the normalized key is never lowercased before being used as a DB key in save_script and other store functions. If a client POSTs a script for username '_GLOBAL', user_exists() returns true (matching '_global' case-insensitively), but the script is stored under the key '_GLOBAL'. A subsequent load_active_script('_global') will find nothing, so the global script silently never applies. Fix: normalize username to lowercase before all store calls, or use a single canonical comparison path.
title: smtp: user_exists bypasses GLOBAL_SCRIPT_KEY normalization
